_meta.purpose: Phase 1/2 labeled ground-truth corpus for .planning/SEARCH-SHAPE-EVAL.md — fixtures-only, no network.
_meta.provenance: Every entry's title/provider is transcribed verbatim (or lightly trimmed of test-only whitespace padding) from a 'happy path' sample object in tests/fixtures/career-ops/providers/<provider>.conformance.mjs, cited per-entry as sourceFixture/sourceLine. These conformance fixtures test wire-format PARSING (title/url/location/date), not full JD prose — none of the 73 vendored provider suites embed a realistic multi-paragraph job-description body in their happy-path samples, because the ATS list endpoints they model don't return one either (JD body is a separate detail fetch that happens later, at search-jobs STEP 4, after triage). bodyText is therefore null for every entry — this mirrors the real STEP 3 coarse-triage moment (title/company/location only, before any body fetch), not a corpus-building shortcut.
_meta.company_and_location_disclosure: Most conformance fixtures use a placeholder company key (or none) rather than a real employer name, since the test only asserts field-mapping, not employer identity. Where a fixture literally names a real company/domain (e.g. greenhouse's Cloudflare/Datadog examples, IBM, Dassault Systemes, ThyssenKrupp Marine Systems, Channable via channable.recruitee.com), that name is reused. Everywhere else 'company' is an agent-assigned generic label of the form '<Provider> Sample Co' / '<Provider>-listed employer', disclosed as such, standing in for 'some employer that posts through this provider.' url is a synthetic slug built from each provider's real API/site domain as it appears in the vendored provider module (src/core/providers/career-ops/vendor/<id>.mjs) — never a live fetched or verified-real posting URL.
_meta.labeling_disclosure: myLabel/myJustification are AGENT-JUDGED, not human-judged — Claude's own read of title+company+location+provider context against examples/demo-workspace/candidate/targeting.yml (role_buckets, keep_signals, cut_signals, excluded_companies) and profile.yml (location/compensation posture). No candidate or hiring-manager reviewed these labels. Bucket scheme is the scorer's own three buckets (high/med/stretch); entries that would read as an outright 'cut' to a human (wrong domain, excluded company) are folded into 'stretch' — the scorer has no fourth bucket — with the cut reasoning stated in the justification text instead.
_meta.synthetic_control: Entry sc-01 is NOT fixture-derived. It's an author-added control case (Software Engineer @ Acme Defense Contractors Inc., the literal excluded_companies entry in the demo targeting.yml) to verify the excluded-company code path actually fires on this corpus.
